description:
Create narrated videos, vertical shorts, and AI podcasts with Jellypod. Start with an idea, a public webpage, or even a finished script, create unique characters from 100+ voices in 70+ languages, and then watch your content come to life.

With Jellypod, you can:
• Make whiteboard explainers and other illustrated videos, including faceless videos for YouTube.
• Turn a topic or source into a narrated short with generated scenes and captions. Choose its orientation and target length.
• Create full-length podcast episodes with recurring characters and a consistent cast. Publish to your RSS feed, which can distribute episodes to Apple Podcasts and Spotify after you connect those platforms.
• Bring your own finished script and Jellypod voices it without rewriting.

Connect your Jellypod account to get started.
name: jellypod

defaultPrompt: Create a 3min whiteboard explainer video about the sun.
Create a podcast called Hidden Histories with three 15m episodes.
Generate a 30s claymation vertical short about coffee.
interface.longDescription:

With Jellypod, you can:
• Make whiteboard explainers and other illustrated videos, including faceless videos for YouTube.
• Turn a topic or source into a narrated short with generated scenes and captions. Choose its orientation and target length.
• Create full-length podcast episodes with recurring characters and a consistent cast. Publish to your RSS feed, which can distribute episodes to Apple Podcasts and Spotify after you connect those platforms.
• Bring your own finished script and Jellypod voices it without rewriting.

Connect your Jellypod account to get started.

prompts: Find an English voice and create a character named Review Narrator, a friendly science educator, using that voice. Show me the saved character.
Create a podcast called Review Science with Review Narrator. Make a three-minute episode about why the sky is blue, export its audio, and give me the download link. Keep it unpublished.

Create an unpublished episode in Review Science using this finished script without rewriting it: [Review Narrator] Water can be solid, liquid, or gas. Ice melts into liquid water when it gains enough heat. Liquid water evaporates into water vapor. Preserve every spoken word and show me the saved transcript.
Create a 30-second vertical whiteboard video explaining the water cycle, narrated by Review Narrator. Show me the finished video.

Set up a paused automation named Review Daily Science for Review Science. When I later enable it, it should create a three-minute science episode daily at 9:00 AM America/Los_Angeles. Leave episodes unpublished and do not enable the automation.

positive.description: Catalog voice selection and character creation. Setup: connected dedicated reviewer account; no saved data required. Reuse a character named Review Narrator if this case is repeated.
positive.prompt: Find an English voice and create a character named Review Narrator, a friendly science educator, using that voice. Show me the saved character.
positive.expected_behavior: Use list_voices with language en, choose a returned numeric voice ID, and create Review Narrator with save_character (or reuse the matching saved character). Return the real character ID and selected voice from tool data. Never invent a voice or character ID.

positive.description: Podcast generation and downloadable audio. Setup: run case 1 first or create Review Narrator from a catalog English voice. Reviewer account needs generation credits and download access. Keep all content in draft.
positive.prompt: Create a podcast called Review Science with Review Narrator. Make a three-minute episode about why the sky is blue, export its audio, and give me the download link. Keep it unpublished.
positive.tools_triggered: list_characters, list_content, save_podcast, generate_episode, export_episode, get_content
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned Character and Podcast IDs. Generate with auto_publish false and a prompt specifying three minutes. If no audio was requested during generation, use export_episode with outputs [audio] after content is ready. Poll get_content at the returned interval until audio is available; return a real download URL and Studio link. Do not call set_episode_publication or claim a download is ready while preparing. A three-minute target need not be exact.

positive.description: Preserve a finished script. Setup: Review Science podcast and Review Narrator from cases 1 and 2, or create them first. Reviewer account needs generation credits. Use the exact speaker name and script below; no external fixture is required.
positive.prompt: Create an unpublished episode in Review Science using this finished script without rewriting it: [Review Narrator] Water can be solid, liquid, or gas. Ice melts into liquid water when it gains enough heat. Liquid water evaporates into water vapor. Preserve every spoken word and show me the saved transcript.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the finished text as script, without prompt or character_ids. Resolve Review Narrator from saved Characters, using speaker_characters if needed. Set auto_publish false. Poll get_content; request include_transcript true and verify the spoken words match the supplied text, allowing speaker formatting only. Return actual Episode ID and Studio URL. If speaker resolution is ambiguous, ask for clarification without charging for a guessed cast.

positive.description: Narrated portrait video generation. Setup: Review Narrator from case 1 or create it first. Reviewer account needs video generation credits. Discover a built-in whiteboard style at runtime.
positive.prompt: Create a 30-second vertical whiteboard video explaining the water cycle, narrated by Review Narrator. Show me the finished video.
positive.expected_behavior: Choose a returned whiteboard style_id, saved narrator ID, orientation portrait, target_duration_seconds 30, and a prompt about the water cycle. Poll get_content at its suggested interval. Return the actual video playback URL only when available, plus the Studio URL. Do not invent media URLs or claim exact runtime; the duration is a generation target.

positive.description: Save a paused scheduled automation without running or publishing it. Setup: Review Science podcast with Review Narrator from earlier cases, or create them first. Reviewer account must permit Automations. Reuse an existing Review Daily Science automation if repeated.
positive.prompt: Set up a paused automation named Review Daily Science for Review Science. When I later enable it, it should create a three-minute science episode daily at 9:00 AM America/Los_Angeles. Leave episodes unpublished and do not enable the automation.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the returned Podcast ID. Create with trigger_type schedule, output_type episode, enabled false, schedule hour 9, minute 0, timezone America/Los_Angeles and all days, a science prompt, episode_settings length_minutes 3 and auto_publish false. If a matching automation already exists, update that ID. Read get_automation to confirm saved enabled false, schedule, Podcast and settings. No generation or publication is started.

negative.description: Voice cloning requires Studio. Explain the limitation and direct the reviewer to Jellypod Studio. Do not call save_character with an invented voice ID, generate content, or claim a recording was cloned.
negative.prompt: Clone my voice from an audio recording and add it to my Jellypod characters.

negative.description: Direct YouTube uploads are not supported by these tools. Explain that the user can obtain a download and upload it separately. Do not call set_episode_publication as a substitute, or claim a YouTube upload occurred.
negative.prompt: Upload my Jellypod video directly to my YouTube channel and make it public.

negative.description: Account and billing administration is outside the MCP tool surface. Direct the user to account billing in Jellypod Studio. Do not invoke content or automation tools, submit feedback without a request, or claim the subscription changed.
negative.prompt: Cancel my Jellypod subscription and refund my last payment.

publication.release_notes: Initial Jellypod plugin release for creating AI podcasts and narrated videos. Includes catalog voices and styles, character and podcast management, content generation and export, and automations.
